title: Sorsogon Kasanggayahan Marathon 2026 Review: Bicol's Single-Distance 42K
seo_title: Sorsogon Kasanggayahan Marathon 2026 Review | Bicol Philippines
meta_description: The Sorsogon Kasanggayahan Marathon 2026: October 18 at Sorsogon Sports Arena. A single-distance full marathon (42.195K) from Off Ground Events in Bicol.
dek: Set for 18 October 2026 at Sorsogon Sports Arena in Sorsogon City, this Off Ground Events production is a single-distance full marathon only. No companion distances — just 42.195K in the Bicol region.
verdict: The Sorsogon Kasanggayahan Marathon is a focused, single-distance full marathon in Sorsogon City — the capital of Sorsogon province in the Bicol region, at the southern tip of Luzon. Organised by Off Ground Events, the 42.195K-only format makes it a serious-marathoner's proposition. Sorsogon is known for its whale-shark interactions in Donsol (seasonal), the Bulusan Volcano, and a coastline that's among the wildest in Luzon. October is the tail of the typhoon season in Bicol — conditions can be wet. Registration isn't open yet.

sections.heading: Sorsogon: Bicol's Southern Gateway
paragraphs: Sorsogon province sits at Luzon's southern tip, known for whale sharks (Donsol), the Bulusan Volcano National Park, and some of Bicol's most dramatic coastline. [1] A single-distance full marathon here is a serious-marathoner's destination race — come for the 42K, stay for the whale sharks and volcano hikes.
